notes: Virginia Roman Catholic and Eastern Orthodox parish additions. Verified via official diocesan/archdiocese/parish websites and Wikipedia. Existing VA RC entries already in directory (NOT duplicated): st-mary-immaculate-conception, st-william-of-york-catholic-stafford, st-matthew-catholic-church, st-jude-catholic-church-fredericksburg. No VA EO parishes existed prior to this pass. All entries red/WARNING per MOOP rubric — RC/EO both reject sola fide.

score_notes.christology: Orthodox Trinitarian; affirms Apostles' and Nicene Creeds, Christ's deity and exclusivity — this is Nicene Christianity at the highest level.
score_notes.scripture: Scripture + Sacred Tradition + Magisterium co-equal (Dei Verbum) — rejects sola scriptura. Classic Protestant/Catholic divide.
score_notes.soteriology: Council of Trent (1547) anathematized justification by faith alone; salvation is faith + works + sacraments (Eucharist, confession, penance, purgatory, indulgences). Fundamental break with Reformation sola fide gospel.
score_notes.gender: Male-only priests; Marian and saint veneration. Catholic teaching does not frame male priesthood in terms of evangelical complementarian biblical patriarchy.
score_notes.leadership: Apostolic succession; bishop-priest-deacon structure with papal oversight. Full diocesan accountability.
score_notes.preaching: Catholic homilies are lectionary-based and typically brief (8-12 min) — not expository in Protestant sense.
score_notes.mission: Great Commission affirmed in Catholic theology; active sacramental ministry and evangelization.
score_notes.cultural: Diocese of Arlington is among the most theologically conservative U.S. dioceses. Recently renovated (2024) in neogothic style — traditional liturgical aesthetic.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Knights of Columbus and men's ministries standard in active Arlington diocesan parishes.
score_notes.denominational: Real oversight — Diocese of Arlington; Cathedral is the bishop's seat. Full apostolic/magisterial accountability.

additions.assessment: The Cathedral of St. Thomas More is the seat of the Diocese of Arlington — one of the most theologically conservative Catholic dioceses in the United States. Trinitarian orthodoxy and male-only priesthood are firmly maintained, and the 2023-2024 neogothic renovation signals liturgical seriousness. The MOOP rubric flags this red on soteriology: Roman Catholic teaching on justification (faith + works + sacraments, Council of Trent) is not Protestant sola fide. Not the right fit for faith-alone evangelicals, but for Catholics seeking reverent liturgy and orthodox moral teaching, this is a flagship parish.
additions.gender_detail: Male-only ordained priesthood; Marian/saint veneration per Catholic tradition. No explicit biblical patriarchal household framework.
